title: Uniqueness for an inverse coefficient problem of a weakly coupled parabolic system
summary: This paper considers the weakly coupled parabolic system $\partial_t u-\partial^2_xu +P(x)u=0$ with the homogeneous Neumann boundary condition, where \(P(x)\) is a \(2\times2\) symmetric real-valued function matrix. Under the assumption that the initial value \(a(x)\) is a generating element (i.e., it has a nonzero inner product with every eigenfunction), we prove that the coefficient matrix $ P(x)$ is uniquely determined by the boundary observation $u(0, t)$, $u(1, t)$, $0 < t < T$.
